Class AlgoAlertEvaluationCoordinator

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.AlgoAlertEvaluationCoordinator
@Service public class AlgoAlertEvaluationCoordinator extends Object
Coordinates shared quote refresh, exchange eligibility and durable per-alert scheduling for every alert entry point.
